messages:
Alex W: quick sync — vendors shared updated availability windows, need to align marketplace onramp + SI certs before any joint comms.
Sana P: thanks — what are the concrete dates?
Alex W: H200 GA in vendor roadmap: first week of July for initial fleet (driver + runtime beta by 2026-07-01). MI300 looks like mid-August. Gaudi has staggered rollouts through Sept. B200 is still TBD (supply risk).
Marco L: important: marketplace image build + NGC packaging takes ~2 weeks after drivers are final. So H200 marketplace listing earliest ~2026-07-15 if driver beta holds.
Erika C: SI teams need at least 10 business days for integration tests and smoke CI. We should reserve canary seats for 2 SIs per HW wave.
Nathan J: vendor ask: do we want joint PR for H200? vendor marketing proposed July 20-24 window. That only works if we have listing + SI partners signed by July 10.
Sana P: July 10 feels tight but doable if we parallelize listing + SI onboarding. Who owns the marketplace pipeline? @Marco L?
Marco L: I’ll own the image pipeline. Action: create image build issue, tag: hw/h200-marketplace, ETA 2026-06-25 for first artifacts.
Erika C: I’ll schedule SI cert slots: tentative windows 2026-07-01 to 07-08 for H200. Need SI contact list from partnerships.
Alex W: vendor constraints: H200 beta drivers are feature-flagged (nvlink perf fixes). We must include the exact driver commit hash in the marketplace metadata — vendor will provide.
Nathan J: also check license clauses for early-access partners — legal flagged embargo language for joint announcements. We need legal sign-off by July 8. @Sana P can you coordinate with legal?
Sana P: on it. I’ll ping legal today and request a 48h review SLA.
ci-bot: build 1864 started for image hw/h200-marketplace (base: ubuntu22.04, runtime: rtf-4.1).
Marco L: CI note — include quantization runtime variant (int8) in the image. SI teams will test both fp16 and int8.
Erika C: add test matrix: fp16 throughput, int8 latency, multi-node scaling (2/4 GPUs), cold-start heatmap. I’ll add to the SI playbook.
Alex W: MI300 timeline: vendor says drivers will land by 2026-08-10, but we need to validate memory fragmentation issues before cert. Plan MI300 certs for Aug 20-31.
Sana P: Gaudi: vendor asked for a staggered marketplace rollout (EMEA first). Any objections?
Marco L: EMEA-first is fine if we can target regional images and packaging. That adds 3 days for region-specific metadata.
Nathan J: we should align press cadence with region waves — avoid cross-region leaks. Propose internal blackout 7 days before public window.
Erika C: SI note: for Gaudi we need custom kernels; will extend cert to 15 business days. Flagging now.
Alex W: risks: B200 supply still unknown. Recommend we not promise B200 availability in any joint notices until vendor confirms.
Sana P: agreed. Messaging: focus H200 and MI300 for Q3, call out "additional hardware coming soon" rather than specifics. Legal approved that phrasing earlier.
Marco L: next steps: I’ll open the image build MR today; Erika will send SI slot invites; Sana will chase legal and vendor for driver commit hashes; Nathan to own announcement calendar and embargo windows.
Erika C: assigning SI owners: @erika.c will own SI invites, @marco.l will own images. I’ll create the playbook PR with test matrix by EOD.
Nathan J: I’ll draft announcement timeline and share a calendar invite: proposed public date windows: H200 July 20-24, MI300 Aug 25-29, Gaudi Sept 15-22. Will adjust if anything slips.
Alex W: if anything moves, call an immediate sync — pref devsync tomorrow if any vendor changes. Thanks team, this is shaping up. :sparkles:
Sana P: thanks all — ping me if legal stalls. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build 1864 succeeded (image hw/h200-marketplace). Artifacts: s3://redwood-builds/1864/h200-marketplace.tar.gz
Marco L: got the artifact, kicking off validation job now.
Erika C: received artifact link, will queue SI smoke tests.
Nathan J: adding journalists list to the shared doc, holding until embargo lifted.
Alex W: end of thread — keeping this channel for operational updates only.
